This method is distinct from general compute shader kernels by focusing specifically on offloading mathematical transformations within the volume rendering pipeline, particularly in OpenGL-based volume mappers [S1, unofficial].

The claim states that the method is distinct by focusing on offloading mathematical transformations (specifically bias and scale computations) within the volume rendering pipeline, particularly in OpenGL-based volume mappers. This confirms that the method involves offloading specific mathematical transformations within an OpenGL-based volume mapper.
